name: Classification Notification Workflow
description: Receives a seasonal article classification run summary from the Seasonal Article Detector Agent and dispatches role-specific notifications to all configured stakeholder groups (demand planners, category managers, supply chain analysts, store managers) via the SAP Agent.

parameters.input: ={{ 'Compose a notification message for a ' + $json.role + ' (detail level: ' + $json.detail_level + '). Run ID: ' + $json.run_id + '. Run date: ' + $json.run_date + '. Total articles classified: ' + $json.total_classified + '. Seasonal articles found: ' + $json.seasonal_count + '. Low confidence classifications: ' + $json.low_confidence_count + '. Dashboard URL: ' + $json.dashboard_url + '. Keep the message concise and role-appropriate. For headline level: one sentence + link. For summary level: 2-3 sentences. For full level: include key stats and call to action.' }}

Compose Notification Message.response: New seasonal article classifications are available. 340 articles classified as seasonal across your planning scope. 45 low-confidence classifications require your review. View the full results in the dashboard: https://dashboard.example.com/seasonal-articles?run=run-001
